findings: The 256-device pure-idle trial failed during setup, before measured idle/probe phases.

The failing device reported a WebSocket upgrade failure before its warmup round timed out. The largest sampled event-loop delay was 251 ms; the available trace does not identify a server capacity threshold.
A later trial with 256 connected devices and eight active devices converged, kept up, completed observations and drained.
Therefore the earlier failure does not establish a 256-device connection ceiling. A repeated pure-idle trial is still required.

findings: Setup failed before exercise: three WebSocket closures occurred within 15 ms at different connection ages (32, 256 and 284 seconds).

findings: The 4096-device target failed in connection warmup. Four connection-attempt timeouts began after 3812 stream-start events; 3824 starts were reported in total, with a sampled peak of 3813 open streams.
No exercise, idle-resume probe or exact user verification completed. This is not a verified 3800-device operating point or a measured established-stream ceiling.
The server instance stayed unchanged. Peak visible cgroup memory was 1546960896 bytes of 4294967296; no OOM was established.

The generator peaked at 22480011264 summed RSS bytes and retained at least 10939432960 host-available bytes. Its memory guard did not fire and reported no monitoring errors. Summed RSS can double-count shared mappings.
The benchmark failed its 30-second cleanup deadline. The independent collector later confirmed zero streams; that later drainage does not erase the cleanup failure.
The unchanged executable subsequently passed the next two-device active screen. A 2048-device pure-idle follow-up is prepared to narrow the tested range.
